name: gpa-predictor-web-app
description: A Streamlit web app that predicts GPA cutoffs for UoA engineering specialisations using historic intake and grade data (2019–2026). Explore trends, compare ML models, and test future scenarios (e.g. 2027) with interactive inputs and feature importance insights.

An interactive Streamlit web app that predicts GPA cutoffs for entry into engineering specialisations at the University of Auckland.
features: Explore historical patterns (2019–2026) between intake data, grade distributions, and actual GPA cutoffs.
Experiment with different machine learning models that you can choose yourself.
Enter hypothetical future scenarios (e.g., 2027) and see predicted GPA cutoffs.
Adjust input variables like Seats Available, Cohort Size, Popularity Score, and average grade statistics.
